name: Design Data Pipeline Change
summary: Design a data-pipeline transition with explicit contracts, replay safety, backfill controls, and reconciliation.
description: Design or review a batch, streaming, ETL, ELT, or dbt pipeline change across producer and consumer contracts, idempotency, backfills, dual running, reconciliation, cutover, and recovery. Use before changing a governed data flow or replaying historical data.
refuses: It does not run production queries, jobs, migrations, backfills, or cutovers without explicit scoped authorization.
It does not infer semantic compatibility from matching column names or accept aggregate counts as complete reconciliation.
It does not hide dropped records, duplicate effects, late data, privacy impact, consumer breakage, or unresolved mismatches.
